description: Held-out v2 evaluation set for the design-engineering skill. Written blind by an independent subagent from the taxonomy only, without reading any skill files, lexicon, scripts, docs, or existing eval cases. Mix of web, mobile, TV, desktop, kiosk, platform-unstated, abstain and adversarial requests.

cases.query: Our React checkout page has the promo code field above the card details and people keep skipping the card form entirely. Can you rework the order of things? Don't touch the header nav.
build me a pricing page in Next.js with three tiers, monthly/yearly toggle, no gradients please and no glassmorphism
the data grid in our Angular admin wraps every cell and rows are like 4 lines tall, on a 1440 monitor you see maybe 12 rows. fix pls
Users on screen readers say our Vue modal dialog is unusable: focus jumps to the page behind and Escape doesn't close it. Please audit and fix.
Svelte marketing site: the hero section looks great on desktop but on a phone the headline is cut off and the CTA is below the fold. Responsive fix needed.
I have a screenshot of a competitor's dashboard I like. Can you rebuild something similar in React + Tailwind? Image attached.
Plain HTML/CSS static site for a bakery. Home page, menu page, contact. Nothing fancy, it must load fast on rural connections.

concepts: system fonts or minimal font loading

cases.query: Our Astro docs site has terrible readability: lines are super wide on large screens and code blocks overflow horizontally on mobile.
React form with 40 fields for insurance claims. Everyone hates it. Split it up or something, but legal says every field must remain required.
design system tokens for our Vue component library: spacing, type ramp, color roles. we ship both a light and a dark theme.
The search results page on our Next.js store shows a blank white screen for 2 seconds then everything pops in. Feels broken.
Make our SaaS settings page in React less of a wall. There are like 60 toggles on one page. No sidebar though, we already have a top nav and want to keep it that way.
new hire onboarding wizard for a web HR portal (Angular). 5 steps. Users are non-technical warehouse staff, many use it on a shared PC in the break room.
Can you review this PR? It adds a notifications dropdown to our React app header. Just want a UX/UI sanity check before merge.
Two brands share our Nuxt storefront codebase and right now they look identical except the logo. Make them feel like different stores without forking the code.
web banking dashboard in React. Show balances, recent transactions, upcoming bills. Users are often 60+.
Our Svelte app's login page: people mistype passwords constantly and there's no show-password toggle, and the error just says 'invalid'. Improve it.
product detail page for a furniture ecommerce site (Next.js). Big images, variants for colour and size, delivery estimate. No carousel dots, no hero banner.
Angular app: the left navigation has 30 items and no grouping. It's a hospital scheduling tool used by nurses on 13 inch laptops.
React: build a delete-account flow. GDPR requires it. Should be hard to do by accident but not annoying.
our vue table has 200 columns of sensor data and users need to compare 3 or 4 at a time. horizontal scrolling is a nightmare rn
Landing page for a developer tool, Astro + Tailwind. Audience is backend engineers who hate marketing fluff.
The colour contrast on our React app fails WCAG in about 40 places according to axe. Mostly grey text on white and our brand blue on buttons. Fix without changing the brand blue itself.

concepts: white text on brand blue check

cases.query: Next.js: make the blog article page nicer. Right now it's just an h1 and paragraphs. Author byline, reading time, related posts. Keep it tasteful, no cards.

concepts: related posts as list not cards

cases.query: Our web app is used by field technicians on tablets outside in bright sun. They say they can't read anything. React.
Rebuild this Figma export into a working React component. It's a filter panel with date range, multi-select tags and a reset button.
Everything in our Angular app animates: menus slide, cards fade, toasts bounce. Several users reported motion sickness. Tone it down properly.
Web-based EHR patient chart (React). Doctors want vitals, meds, allergies and notes all on one screen without scrolling on a 1080p display.
the toast notifications in our svelte app stack up in the corner and cover the save button. also they vanish before anyone reads them

concepts: toast placement away from primary actions

cases.query: Make our React SaaS admin work well on phones. It's desktop-only right now with a fixed 1200px layout. Don't change the information architecture.

concepts: fluid layout instead of fixed width

cases.query: web signup: we ask for name, email, password, company, role, phone, and team size on step 1 and conversion is 11%. Vue.
Our internal tool's empty states just say 'No data'. There are about 15 of them across the React app. Give them proper treatment.
React data table: sort indicators are unclear, users don't know which column is sorted or in what direction. Also the header scrolls away.
Next.js: I want the site header to shrink on scroll and the menu to become a hamburger under 768px. Keep our existing menu items exactly as they are.

concepts: hamburger with visible label or icon plus text

cases.query: Our charts (Recharts in React) have 8 series with similar blues and no one can tell them apart. Also the legend is off-screen on laptops.
Design a 404 and a 500 page for our Vue app. Something that isn't embarrassing but also doesn't try too hard.
Multi-step web checkout in Angular for a pharmacy. Prescription items require ID verification before payment. Make the flow obvious and safe.
Our React file manager uses right-click context menus for everything. Touch users on tablets can't do anything. Fix the interaction model.

concepts: don't hide primary actions behind right-click

cases.query: Svelte: the date picker we use is impossible on mobile, tiny day cells, month arrows too close together.
Audit the whole UI of our React CRM. Not looking for a redesign, just a list of what's inconsistent or wrong.
Chat interface in React for customer support agents who handle 6 conversations at once. Needs to be dense but not confusing.

concepts: conversation list with unread and wait time

cases.query: Our Next.js site's footer has 90 links in 6 columns and on mobile it's a 3-screen scroll of blue text. Help.
React: I need a command palette (ctrl+k) for our app. Should search pages, actions and records.
The Vue app has 4 different button styles for the same 'primary' action depending on which dev built the page. Unify.
Video player controls for our web streaming site (React). Must work with keyboard only and on touch. Subtitles menu, quality menu, speed.
web app for a school. Teachers upload grades in a spreadsheet-like grid. Plain HTML + htmx. Keyboard entry speed is everything.

concepts: tab and arrow key navigation between cells

cases.query: Review the accessibility of our React checkout before launch. We got a legal letter last year.
Angular admin: the breadcrumbs, the page title, and the tab bar all say slightly different names for the same thing. Also the tabs overflow on smaller windows.
Kanban board in React. Drag and drop columns and cards, but also fully usable without a mouse.
Site is a Next.js news publisher. Article pages have 4 ad slots that push content around as they load. Readers complain and Google penalises it.
Convert our Bootstrap 4 admin to a clean custom design in React. Don't add any new npm dependencies.

concepts: own tokens instead of framework defaults

cases.query: web calendar view (Vue) for a clinic. Day/week views, appointments overlap, colour per practitioner. 15 practitioners.

concepts: 15 distinguishable hues is too many so group or filter

cases.query: Our React site's dark mode is just inverted colours and it looks awful: pure black background, pure white text, shadows disappear.

concepts: dark grey surfaces not pure black

cases.query: Flutter app for delivery drivers. They wear gloves in winter and the phone is mounted on the dashboard. Make the active delivery screen usable like that.
SwiftUI onboarding for a meditation app. 3 screens then a paywall. No dark patterns, we've been burned by App Store reviews.
Jetpack Compose: our list screen janks when scrolling, and each row has 6 lines of text. Product is a used-car marketplace.
React Native banking app: users say the transfer confirmation screen is scary and they don't know if the money went. Improve the feedback.
our flutter app has bottom nav with 7 tabs and half of them are truncated. also a hamburger. its a mess
SwiftUI: settings screen with about 25 options. Some are dangerous (sign out everywhere, delete data). Lay it out sensibly.
Compose app for a farm co-op in rural India. Offline most of the day, low-end Android phones, users prefer local language and many have low literacy.

concepts: icon plus text plus audio option

cases.query: React Native: implement this mockup of a music player screen. Screenshot attached. Album art, scrubber, queue button.
Flutter: the search screen shows results only after you press the button and there's no way to see what filters are applied.

concepts: search as you type with debounce

cases.query: SwiftUI health app: the medication reminder screen lets you mark a dose taken with one accidental tap. Pharmacists flagged it as unsafe.
Compose: our checkout has a bottom sheet for address, then another sheet for payment, then another for review. People get lost. Redo the flow.
make our RN app's home screen not look like every other app. we sell artisan coffee subscriptions. no gradient hero, no cards everywhere.

concepts: list or grid without card chrome

cases.query: Flutter app for a bank's field agents in Nigeria: KYC form with photo capture, ID scan, signature. Often no network.
SwiftUI iPad app for restaurant order taking. Waiters hold it one-handed while standing. Menu has 200 items.
Our Compose app fails Play accessibility scanner: touch targets under 48dp, unlabelled icon buttons, text contrast. Fix across the app.
React Native: the pull-to-refresh, the infinite scroll spinner and the initial loader all look different. Also errors just alert().

concepts: no blocking alerts for recoverable errors

cases.query: SwiftUI: our app ignores Dynamic Type. When users bump the text size, labels overlap and buttons clip.

concepts: stack direction changes at large sizes

cases.query: Flutter ecommerce: product list page. Users on cheap phones with 2GB RAM. Images are the main thing but load is slow.
Compose: build a login screen with biometric option and OTP fallback. Fintech, so it needs to feel trustworthy.
our react native app has a floating action button that covers the last row in every list. also on iphones with the home bar it overlaps.

concepts: FAB hides on scroll or alternative placement

cases.query: SwiftUI news app: article detail screen. Readers want to adjust font size, and the images should never be cropped weirdly.
Flutter: we built a tablet layout by just stretching the phone layout. On a 12 inch tablet the form fields are 900px wide.
Compose: the permission request flow asks for camera, location, contacts and notifications all at once on first launch. Users deny everything.

concepts: ask only what the feature needs

cases.query: React Native fitness app: workout in-progress screen. Sweaty hands, phone on the floor, glancing from a distance.
SwiftUI: tab bar plus a side menu plus a top segmented control on the home screen. Simplify our navigation, keep all the destinations reachable.

concepts: segmented control for sibling views only

cases.query: Compose app for construction site inspections. Photos, checklists, signatures. Used in dust, rain, gloves, bright sun.
flutter: dialog boxes everywhere. every action confirms with a dialog. it's exhausting.
React Native: our brand has a strong yellow. The whole app is yellow now and text on yellow is unreadable. Keep the brand recognisable.
SwiftUI parental controls settings for a kids video app. Parents set limits, kids must not be able to change them.
Compose: a receipt scanner app's history list. Thousands of receipts, users search by merchant or amount, group by month.
React Native rideshare driver app: the accept ride button appears while driving and it's tiny and in a different spot each time.
Flutter: design the app for both phone and foldable. On the unfolded screen the app should actually use the space.
Android TV app in Compose: the home screen has rows of posters but you can't tell which one is focused. Users press OK and the wrong thing opens.
Build a settings screen for our tvOS app in SwiftUI. Account, playback quality, subtitles, parental PIN.
Fire TV app: the text at the bottom of the screen gets cut off on some TVs. Also the whole UI looks tiny from the couch.
IPTV set-top box UI for a hotel. Channel list, guide, hotel info, checkout bill. Remote has only arrows, OK, back, and number keys.
Google TV Compose app: the video player controls appear over the video and never go away unless you press back, which exits playback. Ugh.

concepts: back hides controls first then exits

cases.query: tvOS: our search screen forces users to spell everything letter by letter with the remote. It's a cooking video app.
Android TV: detail page for a movie. Play, trailer, add to list, episodes if series. Focus should land somewhere sensible.
We have a web app and a TV app sharing a React codebase (react-native-web + TV build). The TV version has hover states and tiny buttons. Separate the concerns.
Fire TV: the sign-in screen asks users to type an email and password on the remote. Support tickets galore.
Compose for TV: our rows of content scroll so the focused item is always at the left edge, and the row jumps around. Feels janky.
tvOS sports app: live scores dashboard on a TV. Several games at once, updated constantly. It's in sports bars so the TV is far and loud.
Android TV: audit our app for DPAD traps. Somewhere in settings you can get stuck and only Home gets you out.
Design a brand-new Android TV streaming app home in Compose. Please NO horizontal rails, the CEO hates them. Something else.
Set-top box app for a telco. Ancient hardware, 720p, slow CPU. Our current React-based UI drops frames constantly.
tvOS: EPG grid (TV guide). 200 channels, 7 days. Navigating with the Siri remote is painful.
Google TV app: our kids profile looks identical to the adult one. Make it clearly different and safe for a 5 year old with a remote.
Android TV: the subtitles are white on white in bright scenes and the size can't be changed.
Roku-style channel but for Android TV: a radio app. Mostly audio, screen shows now playing. It's on all day in a shop.
tvOS: our onboarding is 8 screens of text. Nobody reads it. Then it asks to pick 10 favourite genres.

concepts: multi-select with remote that is fast

cases.query: Fire TV: implement this design (screenshot) of a live channel overlay with a mini guide at the bottom.
Compose TV: make the app look premium, our competitors look cheap. But performance on budget TVs must not regress.
Android TV app: users with low vision can't see the focus ring and TalkBack doesn't announce which row they're in.
IPTV middleware UI for hospitals. Patients in bed, remote sometimes tethered to the bed rail, screen on an arm. Channels, meal ordering, nurse call info.
tvOS: the app crashes into a blank screen when the network drops mid-stream. Design what the user should see instead.
Compose for TV: build a profile picker screen. Up to 6 profiles, one is kids, add profile option.
Fire TV: our long-press on OK opens a context menu but nobody discovers it. Options like 'remove from list' are hidden there.
Android TV: numbers in our sports stats tables jiggle as they update because digits have different widths.
tvOS: build a 'continue watching' row treatment with progress bars. Should be obvious how much is left.
Google TV: our app uses a mouse-cursor mode because we ported from web. Kill it and make it DPAD-native.
Compose TV: two brands (a sports channel and a movie channel) share our TV app shell. Make them not look like reskins.
Fire TV: the loading spinner sits in the middle of a black screen for 6 seconds on launch. Anything better?
Android TV fitness app in Compose: workout playback with a timer overlay. People are on the floor doing planks looking up at the TV.
WinUI 3 app for warehouse inventory. The main grid has 50k rows and 30 columns, and staff use barcode scanners plus keyboard. Redo the main screen.
WPF: our dialogs have OK on the left sometimes and right other times, and Cancel is occasionally the default. Standardise.
Avalonia app used by air traffic support staff in a control room. Dark room, wall display plus personal monitors. Alerts must be unmissable but not distracting.
WinUI: settings page follows no Windows conventions, custom toggles, custom fonts. Make it feel native.
WPF trading terminal: 6 monitors, hundreds of numbers updating per second. Traders complain their eyes hurt after an hour.

concepts: muted palette with highlight only on change

cases.query: Avalonia: build a preferences window. Cross-platform (Windows, macOS, Linux) so it should feel okay everywhere.
WinUI 3: we have a ribbon, a toolbar, a menu bar and a context menu with the same commands. It's a CAD-ish app. Rationalise the command surfaces.
WPF: accessibility audit. Screen reader users can't use our forms, tab order is random, and high contrast mode breaks everything.
Avalonia point-of-sale for a pharmacy. Prescriptions are dispensed here so mistakes matter. Cashier uses keyboard and a touchscreen.

concepts: large touch targets alongside keyboard flow

cases.query: WinUI: our app opens 12 separate windows over a session. Users lose them. Consolidate without losing the multi-document workflow.
WPF ERP: the invoice entry form has 80 fields across 5 tabs and accountants enter 300 invoices a day. Keyboard speed matters more than looks.
Avalonia: reconstruct this screenshot of a log viewer. Filter bar on top, log lines below, detail pane right.
WinUI 3 app: users on 4K monitors at 150% scaling see blurry icons and misaligned text. Also at 100% on 1080p it's cramped.
WPF app for a lab: technicians enter sample results with gloves on a touchscreen and sometimes with a keyboard. Currently everything is 12px.
Avalonia: our app's dark theme has the same shade of grey for background, panels and disabled text. Nothing has hierarchy.
WinUI: build a first-run experience for our video editing app. Users are creators, mostly experienced with other editors.

concepts: open recent or new project quickly

cases.query: WPF: the status bar shows 'Ready' forever even during 30-second saves. Users click things twice. Feedback overhaul.
Avalonia dashboard for a factory floor: shown on a big screen above the line, no one interacts, updates every minute. Also a version on supervisors' laptops.
WinUI 3: our keyboard shortcuts conflict with Windows defaults and there's no way to see them. Power users are annoyed.

concepts: show shortcuts in menus and tooltips

cases.query: WPF legacy app with 200 screens. We want a design system so new screens stop looking random. Where do we start?
Avalonia: make our data table's selection and multi-select behave like Excel. People expect shift-click and ctrl-click.
WinUI: notifications in our app are a modal popup every time. Users dismiss 50 a day. It's a monitoring tool.
WPF: build a wizard for configuring a network device. 6 steps, some optional, must be able to go back without losing entries.
Avalonia music library app: the album grid re-layouts every time the window is resized and it looks messy. Also the sidebar can't be collapsed.
WinUI 3: reviewers say our app 'looks like Windows 7'. Modernise the visual layer but the workflows must stay exactly the same, users are trained on them.
Self-service kiosk in a fast food restaurant. Large touchscreen, portrait, noisy, people in a hurry, kids too. Build the ordering flow.

concepts: reachable zone for children and wheelchair users

cases.query: hospital check-in kiosk. patients scan ID, confirm details, pay copay. many elderly, some in wheelchairs, privacy in a busy lobby.

concepts: step-by-step with one question per screen

cases.query: Our retail store kiosk (Angular in a locked-down Chrome) shows the desktop website. Customers can't tap the tiny links. Make it kiosk-appropriate.
Ticket vending kiosk for a metro. Outdoors, sun glare, rain, gloves in winter, tourists who don't speak the language.
Museum exhibit touchscreen (Unity or web, undecided). Visitors browse artefacts. Should be beautiful but also survive 500 people a day poking it.
Our pharmacy pickup kiosk shows the prescription name on screen in a queue where people behind can read it. Fix the privacy issue without slowing pickup.
Gym check-in kiosk: members scan a QR and see their class schedule. It's a 10 inch tablet in a stand by the door. Flutter.
airport wayfinding kiosk. touchscreen, portrait, people with luggage, also a keyboard accessibility jack for blind users.
Bank branch kiosk for opening accounts. Long form, ID scan, signature pad. Staff say customers abandon halfway.
Kiosk in a car park to pay for parking. People are angry and in a rush. Payment with card tap or cash. Keep the screens minimal.
our kiosk (React, Electron) works fine but the screen burns in because the same idle screen sits there 20 hours a day
Library self-checkout kiosk. Scan card, scan books, print receipt. Users include children and people with low vision.
Reconstruct this kiosk screen from the photo I took at a competitor's store: category tiles, big search, promo banner at top.
The admin panel table is unreadable, too many columns and everything is the same grey. Help me fix it.
build a settings screen
Our dashboard shows 14 KPIs with equal weight. Execs say they can't find the one number they care about.
make the signup form less annoying
We need a design system. Two products, one team, everything is inconsistent.
the product page feels cluttered
How should I lay out a list of 10,000 items with filters? People need to find one specific item fast.
Error messages in our app are all 'Something went wrong'. Give me a strategy and examples.

concepts: say what happened and what to do

cases.query: Onboarding for our app takes 12 minutes. Cut it down.
Users can't find the export button. It's in a three-dot menu in the top right.

concepts: overflow menu only for rare actions

cases.query: Our app for hotel housekeeping staff. They tick rooms as cleaned. Low literacy, many languages, hurry.
Can you review my screen design? It's a checkout summary. I'll paste the markup.
Our color palette is 30 shades of blue and nobody knows which to use. Simplify into something usable.
the loading experience is bad. spinners everywhere and then everything jumps
We're an ERP vendor. Customers say our screens look like 1998. Modernise without breaking muscle memory for 10,000 daily users.
Data entry screen for nurses recording vitals. Errors here are dangerous.
Our search results page returns nothing half the time and users think the app is broken. It's actually correct, there's just no match.
two brands, same app, we need them to be visually and structurally different, not just a colour swap. what's the approach
help with the navigation of our app. 40 screens, flat structure, users get lost
Design a login screen. Users are doctors, often interrupted, shared workstations.

concepts: no saved credentials on shared devices

cases.query: Home screen for a food delivery app. Nothing built yet.
Our media player screen has 20 controls. Users use 3. Simplify without removing functionality.
audit our app's UI for dark patterns before a regulator does
our notification settings page has 60 checkboxes
I want a landing page that converts. B2B payroll software.
Our Postgres query for the orders report takes 40 seconds. Here's the EXPLAIN output. What index should I add?
Set up a GitHub Actions workflow that runs our Jest tests on every PR and caches node_modules.
JWT refresh tokens: should I store them in an httpOnly cookie or local storage, and how do I rotate them safely?
Write a Terraform module for an S3 bucket with versioning, encryption and a lifecycle rule to Glacier after 90 days.
Our Kafka consumer group keeps rebalancing every few minutes. Lag is growing. How do I debug this?
Migrate our Express REST API to Fastify. Keep the route structure identical.
Write a dbt model that deduplicates customer records by email with the most recent updated_at winning.
Kubernetes pods are getting OOMKilled. Here's the deployment yaml. Fix the resource limits.
Implement rate limiting on our login endpoint with Redis. Sliding window, 5 attempts per 15 minutes per IP.
Write a Python script to backfill missing timestamps in our events table from the S3 raw logs.
Our Dockerfile produces a 2GB image for a Node app. Slim it down.
Design the database schema for a multi-tenant SaaS with row-level security in Postgres.
The Stripe webhook for payment_intent.succeeded fires twice sometimes and we double-fulfil. Make it idempotent.
Our Tailwind build takes 90 seconds in CI. Can you speed up the PostCSS pipeline?
The flex layout on our product cards collapses to zero width when the browser window is between 700 and 820px. React.
Storybook won't start after the webpack 5 upgrade, module not found errors for our icon package.
The icon buttons in our toolbar have no text and users can't tell what they do. Also they're 20px on a touch laptop.

concepts: labels or tooltips plus accessible names

cases.query: Our font files add 800KB to the page and text flashes invisible for 2 seconds. Next.js.
Users say the app 'feels slow' but our API responds in 80ms. React SPA.
Our SVG icons render blurry on Android TV and the CSS transitions on focus stutter. Compose app using WebView for some screens.

concepts: native focus states over CSS transitions

cases.query: Our CSS-in-JS library causes hydration mismatch warnings in Next.js 14.
The z-index of our dropdown is behind the sticky header on some pages, and the dropdown gets clipped in the table container.
Migrate our styles from SCSS to CSS modules. Purely mechanical, don't change how anything looks.
Our design tokens JSON is out of sync with the Figma file. Write a script to diff them.
Our design tokens have 3 different values for 'primary' depending on component and the buttons look different from the links. Sort out the token layer.
Table renders 10k rows and the browser tab freezes. React. Also the header doesn't stay put.
The animation library we use adds 300KB and we only use it for one fade. Replace it.
Our screen reader users report the live chat widget announces every keystroke of the agent typing. Also the widget covers the cookie banner's accept button.

concepts: polite live region for messages only

cases.query: Add ESLint rules to enforce our component naming conventions.
Our React Native app's Android build fails with a duplicate class error after adding a maps SDK.
The map in our React Native delivery app is unreadable at night in the car: white map, tiny labels, the driver squints. Flip it around.

concepts: auto theme by time or ambient light

cases.query: Our Electron desktop app's window remembers the wrong monitor and opens off-screen. Also the title bar buttons are inconsistent with Windows 11.

concepts: window placement validation within visible displays
caption button order and hit size

cases.query: Users tap 'Pay now' twice on slow connections and get charged twice. Flutter checkout.

concepts: processing state with spinner in button

cases.query: Build a web component (vanilla, no framework) for a date range picker we can drop into three legacy apps. No third-party libraries.
